question: Who among the following won the National Film Award for Best Choreography at the 67th National Film Awards?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Raju Sundaram**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Raju Sundaram ** won the National Film Award for Best Choreography at the 67th National Film Awards.

 
 
• **Indian dancer, actor, and director Basava Raju Sundaram predominantly produces dance choreography **for Tamil, Kannada, and Telugu films.
 
• He acted in **movies including Jeans (1998), 123 (2002), I Love You Da (2002), and Quick Gun Murugun (2009)**.
 
• He also** directed **one movie,** Aegan (2008)**.
 
• He is the** elder brother of choreographers Prabhu Deva and Nagendra Prasad and the son of dancer Mugur Sundar**.
 
• At the** 67th National Film Awards, he received the National Film Award for Best Choreography for a song from "Maharshi" (2019)**.
 
• The song was performed by **Vedala Hemachandra and Vishnupriya Ravi and was titled "Everest anchuna." **
 
• **Sri Mani **wrote the** song's lyrics, and Devi Sri Prasad composed the melody**.
 
• Other Telugu movies choreographed by Raju Sundaram include "Republic," "Krack," "Saaho," "Bharat Ane Nenu," and "Gudumba Shankar."
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 67th National Film Awards 

 
 
• **​**The 67th National Film Awards were presented on **March 22, 2021, at a press conference to recognise the top Indian films certified in India between January 1, 2019, and December 31, 2019**.
 
• The awards event, where the** Directorate of Film Festivals honours the best in Indian cinema with its yearly National Film Awards**, was initially scheduled for **3 May 2020 but was postponed because of the COVID-19 pandemic**.
 
• Later, on **October 25, 2021**, it was delivered.
 
• At **Vigyan Bhawan in New Delhi**, the **67th National Awards **are being distributed.
